method: Source-level allocation-request accounting; NOT a runtime allocator measurement.
scope: Verified GT5 source and supplied template-size=498 overlay; successful initialization plus no-finger identification.
limitations: Excludes allocator headers, rounding, fragmentation and other platform allocations.
Configured heap capacity is not observed live/peak heap usage.
Do not add allocation requests to native RAM totals: a linked heap pool already reserves their storage.
The template_buf pointer is included in gt5x_data; its dynamically allocated payload is not.
Inspect native reports for actual retained heap storage in each image; matching Kconfig requests do not prove identical linked storage.
Template transfer paths are not exercised by this test.
